title: Assumption Parish deputies arrest Labadieville resident for felony protective order violation
text:
Assumption Parish deputies arrest Labadieville resident for felony protective order violation
R. I. Reed
Deshown Burdis, 37, of Labadieville, was arrested on Aug. 8 in Napoleonville on felony charges related to violations of a protective order, according to the Assumption Parish Sheriff’s Office.
Deputies responded to a complaint on Violet Street and spoke with the complainant, who stated that she had an active protective order against Burdis. The complainant detailed several instances where Burdis allegedly violated the terms of the order. Based on this information, deputies obtained arrest warrants for Burdis.
On Wednesday morning, deputies located Burdis and attempted to make an arrest. According to the sheriff’s office report, Burdis violently resisted and committed battery upon one of the deputies during the process.
Burdis was subsequently arrested and booked into the Assumption Parish Detention Center. The charges include violation of a protective order, resisting arrest by force or violence, and battery of a police officer. She remains incarcerated pending a bond hearing.
For further information regarding this case or news release, contact Sheriff Leland Falcon or Public Information Officer Lonny Cavalier at (985) 498-9353 or (985) 369-2912.
